MERGE INTO CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO CII USING (
SELECT '${item.registBankCode}' REGIST_BANK_CODE, '${item.indentifyMark}' INDENTIFY_MARK, '${item.prodid}' PRODID, '${item.prdRegistCode}' PRD_REGIST_CODE, #{item.holdDate,jdbcType=DATE}null HOLD_DATE, '${item.ccy}' CCY, ${item.amount}null AMOUNT, ${item.qty}null QTY, ${item.cnyAmt}null CNY_AMT, '${item.remark}' REMARK, '${item.dataSource}' DATA_SOURCE, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.agent}' AGENT, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, '${item.interfCheckResult}' INTERF_CHECK_RESULT FROM sysibm.sysdummy1
) TEMP
ON(CII.REGIST_BANK_CODE = TEMP.REGIST_BANK_CODE AND CII.INDENTIFY_MARK = TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK
AND CII.PRODID = TEMP.PRODID AND CII.HOLD_DATE = TEMP.HOLD_DATE AND CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT,CII.QTY = TEMP.QTY,CII.CNY_AMT = TEMP.CNY_AMT,CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS,CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER,CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.AGENT=TEMP.AGENT, CII.PRD_REGIST_CODE = TEMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (REGIST_BANK_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, PRODID, PRD_REGIST_CODE, HOLD_DATE, CCY, AMOUNT, QTY, CNY_AMT, REMARK, DATA_SOURCE, STATUS, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME,AGENT,CREATE_DEPT,INTERF_CHECK_RESULT) VALUES(TEMP.REGIST_BANK_CODE, TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK, TEMP.PRODID, TEMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE, TEMP.HOLD_DATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.AMOUNT, TEMP.QTY, TEMP.CNY_AMT, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.AGENT,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT,TEMP.INTERF_CHECK_RESULT)

MERGE INTO CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB CII USING (
SELECT '${item.registSeqno}' REGIST_SEQNO, '${item.registBankCode}' REGIST_BANK_CODE, '${item.indentifyMark}' INDENTIFY_MARK, '${item.prdRegistCode}' PRD_REGIST_CODE, #{item.holdDate,jdbcType=DATE}null HOLD_DATE, '${item.ccy}' CCY, ${item.amount}null AMOUNT, ${item.qty}null QTY, ${item.cnyAmt}null CNY_AMT, '${item.remark}' REMARK, #{item.chbSubmitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, #{item.submitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null SUBMIT_DEADLINE, '${item.sendStatus}' SEND_STATUS, #{item.statusDate,jdbcType=DATE}null STATUS_DATE, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, '${item.checkSeqno}' CHECK_SEQNO, '${item.prodid}' PRODID, '${item.registSeqno}' SUMIT_SEQ FROM sysibm.sysdummy1
) TEMP
ON(CII.REGIST_BANK_CODE = TEMP.REGIST_BANK_CODE AND CII.INDENTIFY_MARK = TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK AND CII.PRD_REGIST_CODE = TEMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND CII.HOLD_DATE = TEMP.HOLD_DATE AND CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY AND CII.INDENTIFY_MARK = TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK AND CII.PRODID = TEMP.PRODID
AND CII.SEND_STATUS = TEMP.SEND_STATUS )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT,CII.QTY = TEMP.QTY,CII.CNY_AMT = TEMP.CNY_AMT,CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS,CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER,CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,CII.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE=TEMP.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, CII.SUBMIT_DEADLINE=TEMP.SUBMIT_DEADLINE,CII.STATUS_DATE=TEMP.STATUS_DATE,CII.CHECK_SEQNO=TEMP.CHECK_SEQNO, CII.SUMIT_SEQ=TEMP.SUMIT_SEQ
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (REGIST_SEQNO,REGIST_BANK_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, PRD_REGIST_CODE, HOLD_DATE, CCY, AMOUNT, QTY, CNY_AMT, REMARK,STATUS, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME,CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE,SUBMIT_DEADLINE,SEND_STATUS,STATUS_DATE,CREATE_DEPT,CHECK_SEQNO,PRODID, SUMIT_SEQ) VALUES(TEMP.REGIST_SEQNO,TEMP.REGIST_BANK_CODE, TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK, TEMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE, TEMP.HOLD_DATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.AMOUNT, TEMP.QTY, TEMP.CNY_AMT, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE,TEMP.SUBMIT_DEADLINE,TEMP.SEND_STATUS,TEMP.STATUS_DATE,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT,TEMP.CHECK_SEQNO,TEMP.PRODID, TEMP.SUMIT_SEQ)
